cases.scope: One preexisting queued thread and one delayed publisher referring to the same permanent processor slot across one successful retirement/reuse. Source-inspired controls drop an undrained queue on reset or publish through an obsolete slot generation. Proposed lock-protected admission, drain and generation revalidation are abstract; no source implementation or native stale-publication failure is claimed. Existing thread-drain and saved-stack models remain separate required obligations, not imported or discharged. Assumes fair scheduling, successful root-preserving transfer and join, no cancellation or permanent pin.
